'''Volos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] who was deployed at the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Volos, his squads, and CorSec's [[Tactical Response Team]]s made progress against the Empire's forces near the main rocket tram station in the Government District of the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], but were unable to proceed until a Republic hero managed to eliminate the Imperial shock troopers guarding the mortar cannons and destroy the weapons.
